targets.rawSQL: SELECT timestamp_mccs AS time, COALESCE(double_value, CAST(int_value AS DOUBLE), CAST(uint_value AS DOUBLE)) AS value, mrid AS metric FROM sessions.wama.measurement_values WHERE blob_id = '$blob_id' AND mrid IN ($mrid) AND value_type IN ($value_type) AND $__timeFilter(timestamp_mccs) ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT status, measurement_count, started_at, ended_at, finalized_at, object_parquet_schema_version, object_byte_length FROM blobmeta.blobmeta_catalog.session_blobs WHERE blob_id = '$blob_id'
SELECT mrid, measurement_count FROM blobmeta.blobmeta_catalog.session_blob_mrids WHERE blob_id = '$blob_id' ORDER BY mrid

list.definition: SELECT blob_id FROM blobmeta.blobmeta_catalog.session_blobs WHERE status IN ('COMPLETE', 'PARTIAL') ORDER BY finalized_at DESC
list.name: blob_id
list.query: SELECT blob_id FROM blobmeta.blobmeta_catalog.session_blobs WHERE status IN ('COMPLETE', 'PARTIAL') ORDER BY finalized_at DESC

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT mrid FROM sessions.wama.measurement_values WHERE blob_id = '$blob_id' ORDER BY mrid
list.name: mrid
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT mrid FROM sessions.wama.measurement_values WHERE blob_id = '$blob_id' ORDER BY mrid

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT value_type FROM sessions.wama.measurement_values WHERE blob_id = '$blob_id' AND value_type IN ('double', 'int', 'uint') ORDER BY value_type
list.name: value_type
